hero.sub: While others studied resilience, we practiced it daily. We turned it into structured AI roles — open, free, built for the real world.

philosophy.sub: When noise surrounds you — you need structure. When systems collapse — you need protocol.

pillars.label: Structured Thinking
pillars.description: Each role is a protocol — not a conversation starter. It follows a defined architecture with identity, archetype, and session structure.

pillars.label: Emotional Stabilization
pillars.description: Built for acute and chronic stress environments. Roles provide cognitive scaffolding when internal resources are depleted.

pillars.label: Strategic Decision Support
pillars.description: Clarity over comfort. Roles help users move from paralysis to action through structured frameworks, not motivational language.

categories.heading: Five categories
categories.sub: The full spectrum of human crisis support.

cta.sub: Download any role as a plain text file. Insert it at the start of any LLM conversation. The role activates immediately — no API, no account, no lock-in.
